fish.title: D3 AKS · Pulumi · ArgoCD
fish.blurb: New AKS cluster brought up across Pulumi IaC, ArgoCD and monitoring; GitOps migration from k3s to AKS in progress.
fish.description: Platform track at D3 Security — brought up a new AKS cluster across Pulumi IaC, ArgoCD and monitoring: site service principal, App Gateway path rule, an ArgoCD instance with apps cloned from the existing POC cluster, and monitoring environment values. Also leading an in-progress GitOps migration of customer sites from self-managed k3s to Azure AKS, with reusable migration scripts and post-cutover data checks.

fish.title: D3 Go Kubernetes operator
fish.blurb: Lifecycle operator features — one autoscaling mode (HPA, KEDA or off), conflicting-HPA guard, sync-all verb.
fish.description: DevOps track — built features in a Go Kubernetes operator that manages sites and apps: a single autoscaling mode (HPA, KEDA or off) with a guard against conflicting HPAs, a KEDA dashboard, a sync-all verb, and alert rules that send cluster crash and high-usage alerts to Google Chat. Roughly 100 commits across v2.1.22 → 2.1.32.

fish.title: D3 monitoring · Alertmanager relay
fish.blurb: AI token-cost monitoring and an Alertmanager → Google Chat relay with one thread per firing episode.
fish.description: Monitoring track — built AI token-cost monitoring (Postgres collectors, Prometheus rules, Grafana dashboard, per-region Chat routing) and an Alertmanager → Google Chat relay that opens one thread per firing episode, on a Prometheus / Thanos / Alertmanager / Grafana stack.

fish.title: D3 AI DevOps agent fleet
fish.blurb: Planner / worker / reviewer agents with a read-only verify gate and human approval for prod, IAM, network and secrets.
fish.description: AI DevOps track — designed and built a multi-agent DevOps system on Claude Code: planner, worker and reviewer agents, a read-only verify gate, git worktree isolation, PR automation, and human approval for production, IAM, network and secrets changes — nothing is applied or pushed without approval. An eight-step reviewed fleet run delivered a pipeline that pins image digests per site and cluster through a pull request, with fail-closed hold-list parsing.

timeline.title: D3 Security — DevOps Engineer (job)
timeline.body: AKS cluster bring-up + GitOps, Go Kubernetes operator (HPA/KEDA), Alertmanager relay, AI DevOps agent fleet with human approval gates. AKS migration in progress.
